name: @battuta/plugin-playback
description: The page-view player: the transport row, the sampled piano, the MIDI-out sink and the playback-MIDI export — one performance, two sinks.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
./performance is exported so the performance model can be read from outside the package without reaching into src/ by path; nothing in the app imports it.

dependencies: @battuta/api, react (the transport row renders into the docHeader slot) and tone (the instrument — the host owns the AudioContext, a plugin brings its own sampler; allowed since slice 7a). Nothing else of the workspace.
